findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice mcqs for Unit 9 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 82 questions numbered 1-82; by section: 9.1 7, 9.1.1 11, 9.1.2 9, 9.1.3 9, 9.1.4 7, 9.1.5 6, 9.1.6 17, 9.2 16. Keys: {'a': 20, 'b': 21, 'c': 20, 'd': 21}.

Covers 9.1 (introduction), 9.1.1-9.1.6 (the six inverse functions, their domains, ranges, graphs, Examples 2-7 methods) and 9.2 (the six sum and difference formulas, double results, conditions, equations) in book order, with new values (no exercise question or book example repeated). Book corrections followed: graphs of a function and its inverse are mirror images in y = x; csc maps onto (-inf, -1] U [1, inf); cos(a + b) = cos a cos b - sin a sin b; 2cos^-1 x = cos^-1(2x^2 - 1) comes from (iii); cot^-1 x = tan^-1(1/x) only for x > 0. Every key and distractor of the computational questions was checked numerically (check9.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
